summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to report a material definitive agreement. On May 1, 2026, its indirect subsidiaries entered into a $3,800,000 commercial business loan agreement with Hancock Whitney Bank to refinance existing mortgage debt on two properties. The term loan bears interest at 5.70%, requires monthly payments of $23,986.17 based on a 25-year amortization, and matures on May 1, 2031. It is secured by first-priority mortgages and assignments of rents. The filing describes routine financing terms and customary covenants, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review.
